text:
Timo Meier has one goal in 17 games. He also has 65 shots, 6.08 expected goals from his own looks, and eight shots in each of two games during a nine-game drought. This is about as clear a case of bad luck as our numbers produce: 1.5 percent shooting from a player whose range sits near ten.

It isn't only his shooting. New Jersey has scored 7.2 fewer goals than expected with him on the ice, which is why he has five points while the Devils control 60 percent of the 5v5 expected goals during his shifts. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking last season had him in the 87th percentile for chances from the slot and carrying the puck in on 54 percent of his entries.

The frustration is starting to show: 17 penalty minutes and a game misconduct in one recent win. Our wins-added list has him 497th of 499, which tells you about results, not process. Our range still expects 21 goals by April.
headline: Meier is shooting into a wall
